channels.name: ego_pose
channels.method: original Native subject actor transform and body extent joined to frame map
channels.time_window: all 600 frames including reference approach and intersection exit
channels.reference_frame: original CARLA world XY and native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling and physical camera coverage require independent review

channels.name: ego_stop_and_yield_sequence
channels.method: original Native ego/through-vehicle motion, bodies, governing sign, reference and control state joined to four source camera identities
channels.time_window: all 600 frames, including while moving across or within intersection
channels.reference_frame: original Native frame, surveyed road and reference geometry
channels.uncertainty: immediate hazard, yielding and legal applicability require human review of original sources

context_inputs.name: governing_control
context_inputs.method: original sign, officer or traffic-signal object and per-frame controlling state readback

context_inputs.name: stopping_reference_hierarchy
context_inputs.method: source-hashed marked line, near-side crosswalk or sight-ray/viewpoint geometry

context_inputs.name: through_highway
context_inputs.method: source-hashed road geometry and through-vehicle actor identity

limitations: Requested stopping policy and fixture trajectory are not observed motion or a legal verdict.
Source video pixels, official control state, physical completion and legal immediate hazard remain for local independent review.

cameras.name: overview
cameras.pose_strategy: surveyed fixed world transform showing both roads, sign and full crossing

cameras.name: approach
cameras.pose_strategy: surveyed fixed world transform showing governed approach and reference

cameras.name: reference_corner
cameras.pose_strategy: surveyed fixed world transform showing line/crosswalk/viewpoint and through road

cameras.name: driver_reference
cameras.pose_strategy: attached subject driver reference with through-highway view
